definitions.explanation: The act of offering incense at a Buddhist funeral, memorial service, or when visiting a grave. A key ritual in which mourners take turns approaching the altar to burn powdered incense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{焼香|しょうこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{焼香|しょうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わからず⟦{戸惑|とまど}った→戸惑う：06036_tomadou⟧。
examples.english: I was flustered at the funeral because I didn't know the proper way to offer incense.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
At Japanese Buddhist funerals and memorial services, {焼香|しょうこう} involves pinching powdered incense ({抹香|まっこう}) and sprinkling it onto a burner. The number of times one does this varies by Buddhist sect (typically one to three times). The etiquette can be confusing for younger Japanese and foreigners.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼香|しょうこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to burn/offer incense)
- {焼香|しょうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to offer incense)
- {焼香|しょうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧ (the order of incense offering)
- {焼香|しょうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧ (incense offering etiquette)
- {焼香|しょうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧ (to visit to offer incense)

FORMS:
{焼|しょう} (to burn) + ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧ (incense).
